articles.title: Kraken Wins $22M From Auditor That Abandoned It During Operation Choke Point 2.0
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange says an arbitrator sided with it after accounting firm Mazars walked away from a nearly finished audit.

articles.title: SEC's Long-Promised Crypto Safe Harbor to Be Introduced as Soon as This Month
articles.snippet: The SEC updated its agenda to indicate that a key crypto rulemaking is slated to be released for public comment in July.
